name: Four Seasons Hotel Singapore
positioning: Four Seasons hotel at 190 Orchard Boulevard in Singapore, a three-minute walk from Orchard MRT
best_for: Travelers who want a base near the Orchard MRT station
Guests who want Cantonese and Japanese-Peruvian dining at the hotel

facts.text: The hotel is at 190 Orchard Boulevard in Singapore.
The Orchard MRT station is a three-minute walk from the hotel.
Jiang-Nan Chun is a Michelin-recommended Cantonese restaurant at the hotel.
One-Ninety Restaurant combines Asian and Western cuisine in a botanical-inspired brasserie setting.
The rooftop Family Pool is on the 20th floor.
The third-floor outdoor Lap and Quiet Pool is one of the hotel's two pools.
The hotel has three outdoor courts for tennis, pickleball and padel.
The Chi Longevity Clinic is a medically licensed clinic at the hotel.

highlights.text: The hotel describes its Deluxe Hypoallergenic Rooms as Singapore's first completely hypoallergenic rooms.
Club Room guests get all-day Executive Club access.
Condé Nast Traveler says the Peking duck at Jiang Nan Chun isn't to be missed.
Condé Nast Traveler says the rooms start from a sprawling 527 square feet.
The Spa and Wellness Lunch package includes a 90-minute Peranakan Signature Therapy Massage.

considerations.text: The spa facilities are open from 9:00 am to 9:00 pm.
Executive Club access in the Premier Suite carries a supplement fee.
Singapore Changi Airport is 30 minutes by car from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
